Notice.DsnActive: Dicer is inactive while Dice So Nice is enabled. Disable one of them.

enabled.Name: Enable 3D dice
enabled.Hint: Throw 3D dice for chat rolls on this client.

diceLookButton.Name: Dice look button on actor sheets
diceLookButton.Hint: Show a Dice look button in the header of the sheets of actors you own; it opens the theme browser for that actor.

pixelRatioCap.Name: Pixel ratio cap
pixelRatioCap.Hint: Upper limit for the dice canvas pixel ratio. Lower is faster. Requires a reload.

diceScale.Name: Dice size
diceScale.Hint: Size of the dice on screen.

timeBeforeHide.Name: Time before hiding (ms)
timeBeforeHide.Hint: How long the dice stay on the table after landing, before they fade out.

maxDice.Name: Maximum dice per message
maxDice.Hint: Dice beyond this number are not thrown.

theme.Name: Dice theme
theme.Hint: The look and impact sound of your dice. Other players see your dice in this theme too.

worldDefaultTheme.Name: World default theme
worldDefaultTheme.Hint: The theme players' dice use when they have not chosen one of their own. Players keep their own choices unless 'Lock player looks' is on; the theme browser can also push it to every player.

lockPlayerLooks.Name: Lock player looks
lockPlayerLooks.Hint: Players' dice always use the world default theme, whatever they have chosen. Needs a world default theme. GMs are not affected, and a roll or damage type that names its own colorset or theme still does.

quality.Name: Graphics quality
quality.Hint: Auto measures your GPU once and picks a tier. Lower tiers are faster; the world cap still applies. If rolls stutter, Dicer lowers the tier for this session; choosing a quality here tries again at your choice.

showGhostDice.Name: Show ghost dice for hidden rolls
showGhostDice.Hint: Players see neutral, blank dice when a whispered roll or their own blind roll is hidden from them. This reveals that a hidden roll happened, never its result.

migrateFromDsn.Name: Import Dice So Nice settings
migrateFromDsn.Hint: On first load, copy each user's Dice So Nice dice colours and the world's Dice So Nice settings into Dicer. Choices already made in Dicer are kept.

hideInitiative.Name: Hide initiative until the dice land
hideInitiative.Hint: In the combat tracker, a combatant's rolled initiative stays hidden until the dice of its initiative roll have landed. When chat messages are shown immediately, the tracker shows the value at once too, as the chat card already does.

showExtraDice.Name: Show extra dice
showExtraDice.Hint: Also throw dice whose results do not count, such as the dropped die of an advantage roll or rerolled dice.

petsAllowed.Name: Allow dice pets
petsAllowed.Hint: Players' pets hop in to throw their dice and react to a natural 20 or 1.

showPets.Name: Show dice pets
showPets.Hint: See your own and other players' pets when they roll.

petSounds.Name: Pet sounds
petSounds.Hint: Your pet's happy and sad chirps.

petStay.Name: How long pets stay
petStay.Hint: How long a pet stays on the table after its owner's last roll. Pets move out of your cursor's way while they wait.

petSplat.Name: Dice can splat pets
petSplat.Hint: A die that hits a pet hard enough splats it until its owner rolls again.

immediatelyDisplayChatMessages.Name: Show chat messages immediately
immediatelyDisplayChatMessages.Hint: Roll messages appear in the chat at once instead of waiting for the dice to land. The dice still animate.

qualityCap.Name: Maximum graphics quality
qualityCap.Hint: Upper limit on the dice quality tier for every player in this world.

interiors.Name: Dice interiors
interiors.Hint: Draw the liquid, glitter, swirl and nebula interiors of resin dice. Off is faster.

engraving.Name: Engraved numbers
engraving.Hint: Shade the numbers as engraved into the die. Off draws them flat.

shadows.Name: Dice shadows
shadows.Hint: Draw a soft shadow under each die.

glow.Name: Dice glow
glow.Hint: Let glowing looks emit light. Off keeps them unlit.

presetFaces.Name: Picture and symbol faces
presetFaces.Hint: Draw the pictures and symbols that dice presets from other modules put on their faces. Off shows plain numbers instead.

presetModels.Name: 3D model dice
presetModels.Hint: Show the 3D dice models that dice presets from other modules provide, for the die types whose face layout Dicer has verified. Off shows Dicer's own dice instead.

sounds.Name: Dice sounds
sounds.Hint: Play impact sounds as the dice hit the table, the walls and each other.

soundVolume.Name: Dice sound volume
soundVolume.Hint: How loud the impact sounds are.

effectsVolume.Name: Effects volume
effectsVolume.Hint: How loud the sounds of special effects and results are.

quietWhenUnfocused.Name: Quieter when the window is unfocused
quietWhenUnfocused.Hint: Lower the dice sounds while this browser tab or window is not focused.

soundSurface.Name: Table surface
soundSurface.Hint: What the dice land on, for every player in this world. Players can override it for themselves.

soundSurfaceOverride.Name: My table surface
soundSurfaceOverride.Hint: Hear a different surface than the world's setting.

muteCoreDiceSound.Name: Silence Foundry's dice sound
muteCoreDiceSound.Hint: Foundry plays its own dice clatter on every roll card. Dicer's dice make their own sounds, so turn this off only if you want both.

effects.Name: Special effects
effects.Hint: Play effects and result sounds when a die shows a triggering result, such as a natural 20. Effects never play for rolls you cannot see.

showOthersEffects.Name: Show other players' effects
showOthersEffects.Hint: Also play the effects of other players' rolls. Off plays only the effects of your own rolls.

slowMotion.Name: Slow motion
slowMotion.Hint: Slow the landing down on this screen when a die celebrates or fumbles. Other players' timing is never affected.

screenShake.Name: Screen shake
screenShake.Hint: Let effects shake the dice briefly. Only the dice move, never the map. Off when your system asks for reduced motion.

impactEffects.Name: Impact effects
impactEffects.Hint: Small dust and sparks where dice hit the table.

perPlayerAreas.Name: Per-player roll areas
perPlayerAreas.Hint: Throw each player's dice in the area the GM gave them, on every screen. Off throws everyone's dice in the default area.

areaScale.Name: Roll area size
areaScale.Hint: Make every roll area bigger or smaller on this screen only, around its centre. Other players' screens are not affected.

gmPrivateCorner.Name: GM private corner
gmPrivateCorner.Hint: On the GM's screen, throw rolls only GMs can see (blind or GM-only whispers) in their own corner. Players' screens are never affected.

rollAreaEditor.Name: Roll areas
rollAreaEditor.Label: Edit roll areas
rollAreaEditor.Hint: Choose where dice land: a default area, one for each player and an optional GM private corner. Players can only preview their own area.

benchmark.Name: Dice benchmark
benchmark.Label: Run the dice benchmark
benchmark.Hint: Throws a few test rolls on this screen only and shows how smoothly they run. Nothing is posted to chat or sent anywhere.

damagePresets.Name: Damage dice themes
damagePresets.Hint: Give damage dice a look, impact sound and landing effect by damage type (fire, cold, acid and so on). Off shows your own dice. Never depends on the special effects setting.

damageMap.Name: Damage type map
damageMap.Label: Edit damage dice themes
damageMap.Hint: Choose the look, colors and landing sound of each damage type's dice. Everyone can set their own override; the GM sets the world choices.

themeBrowser.Name: Theme browser
themeBrowser.Label: Browse dice themes
themeBrowser.Hint: Browse built-in, world and your own dice themes with live previews, use one as your default, for a die type, a roll type, one of your characters or a damage type, and duplicate, edit, import or export your own. A GM can also publish themes to the world.

appearanceEditor.Name: Appearance editor
appearanceEditor.Label: Design your dice
appearanceEditor.Hint: Build a dice look layer by layer (body, inside, numbers and font, edges, glow, a look per die type) with a live turning preview, and save it as one of your themes. A GM can also save it as a world theme.

triggerEditor.Name: Trigger rules
triggerEditor.Label: Edit trigger rules
triggerEditor.Hint: Choose which effects, sounds and macros fire for which dice results. Everyone has their own rules; the GM edits the world rules.

triggerMacros.Name: Trigger macros
triggerMacros.Hint: Let trigger rules run a macro when they fire. The macro runs once, on the roller's client.

Triggers.Title: Dicer trigger rules
Triggers.WorldHint: World rules apply to every player's rolls. Module rules come from other modules and can be switched off, not edited.
Triggers.MineHint: Your own rules apply to your rolls, after the world rules.
Triggers.ReadOnly: Only a GM can edit the world rules. You can preview them.
Triggers.Name: Name
Triggers.ModuleRuleHint: From another module: switch it on or off here; it cannot be edited.
Triggers.NoneSelected: No rules yet. Add one to start.
Triggers.Label: Face label
Triggers.Macro: Drop a macro here, or paste its UUID
Triggers.ResetConfirm: Replace the world rules with the two defaults? Module rules are kept. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
Triggers.NotGM: Only a GM can save the world rules.
Triggers.Unreadable: Some saved trigger rules could not be read. They are kept, highlighted; fix or delete them.
Triggers.UnreadableRule: This saved rule could not be read and is kept unchanged. Delete it to remove it.
Triggers.PreviewUnavailable: Preview needs the 3D dice to be running.

AreaEditor.Title: Dicer roll areas
AreaEditor.GMHint: Drag the rectangle to move it and its handles to resize it. Each area keeps a minimum size and stays on screen. Save writes only the areas you changed.
AreaEditor.PlayerHint: This is where your dice land on this screen. Only the GM can change it; the Roll area size setting scales it for you.
AreaEditor.SaveFailed: Dicer: the roll area could not be saved.

Effects.PreviewOff: Effects are turned off in Dicer's settings.

Bench.Title: Dicer benchmark
Bench.Intro: Throws a few test rolls on this screen and measures how smoothly they animate. Wait for the dice to clear first. It takes under a minute.
Bench.CopyFailed: Dicer: could not copy the summary.
Bench.Busy: Dicer: dice are still rolling or a benchmark is running. Try again when the table is clear.
Bench.Disabled: Dicer: 3D dice are turned off, so there is nothing to benchmark. Enable them first.
Bench.Private: Nothing is posted to chat or sent anywhere. The summary is only copied if you press Copy summary.
Bench.Unavailable: The dice engine is not running, so there is nothing to benchmark.

DamageMap.Title: Dicer damage type map
DamageMap.GMHint: World choices apply to everyone; your override applies to your dice only. A custom landing sound replaces the theme's own.
DamageMap.PlayerHint: Your override applies to your dice only. Only a GM can change the world choices and landing sounds.
DamageMap.Unreadable: Some stored damage map entries cannot be shown here and are kept as they are:
DamageMap.NoTheme: This damage type has no theme here, so your own dice are used.
DamageMap.PreviewUnavailable: Preview needs the 3D dice to be running.

Themes.Title: Dicer themes
Themes.ThrowHint: Roll one of each die with this theme on the table (only you see it).
Themes.ClearHint: Stop using any theme choice for the selected place
Themes.StoredUnusable: Dicer could not read the stored data, so it was left unchanged. Fix or reset it in the settings first.
Themes.NotAllowed: That is not possible here (you may not own that character, or only a GM can do it).
Themes.NothingToExport: You have no themes of your own to export.
Themes.ImportFailed: The theme file could not be imported.
Themes.Locked: Your GM has set everyone's dice.
Themes.PushHint: Make this every player's default theme (GM)
Themes.PushConfirm: Make this every player's default theme:
Themes.PushReplaceAll: Replace everything: also clear their per-die-type and per-roll-type choices
Themes.PushNotShared: Only built-in and world themes can be pushed: players cannot see your own themes. Publish it to the world first.
Themes.ConfirmDeleteWorldDefault: It is the world default theme: deleting it also clears the world default, and players go back to their own default dice.
Themes.Unreadable: Some stored themes cannot be read by this version and are kept as they are:

Quality.Dropped: Dicer lowered the dice graphics quality for this session to keep rolls smooth.

Appearance.Title: Dicer appearance editor
Appearance.ThrowHint: Roll one of each die with this look on the table (only you see it).
Appearance.DieType: Die type shown in the preview
Appearance.DragHint: Drag to turn, double-click to reset
Appearance.PreviewUnavailable: The live preview needs the 3D dice to be running.
Appearance.ExportLook: Export this look to a file
Appearance.ImportLook: Import a look from a file

Pet.Title: Pet
Pet.Hint: Your pet throws your dice and reacts to a natural 20 or 1. Everyone sees it.
Pet.Hidden: You have dice pets hidden (Dicer settings).

Inside.ResinOnly: Only clear resin dice have an inside. Choose Clear resin under Body to add one.

Numbers.IconsHint: Only d20s show icons; every other die keeps its numbers.
Numbers.FontInvalid: That is not a usable font name or file path, so the serif is used. Font names use letters, digits, spaces and dashes; files end in .ttf, .otf, .woff or .woff2 and must be on this Foundry server (a path in its data folder, not a web address).
Numbers.FontFailed: This font could not be loaded, so the serif is shown instead. Check the name or the file.

PerType.Hint: Give a die type its own look. Every other die type uses the default look above.

Appearance.Name: Theme name
Appearance.SaveWorldHint: Everyone in the world can use it (GM)
Appearance.NeedName: Give the theme a name first.
Appearance.DiscardChanges: The appearance editor has unsaved changes. Discard them and open the other look?
Appearance.NotAllowed: Only a GM can save world themes, and only your own themes can be updated.
Appearance.StoredUnusable: Dicer could not read the stored themes, so nothing was saved. Fix or reset them in the settings first.
Appearance.BadLook: That is not a Dicer look (expected the JSON of one appearance).
Appearance.ClipboardUnavailable: The clipboard is not available here.
